label: Orders
caption: MICHIGAN SENATE, ET AL. V. LEAGUE OF WOMEN VOTERS, ET AL.
text: The application for stay presented to Justice Sotomayor and by her referred to the Court is granted, and it is ordered that the order of the United States District Court for the Eastern District of Michigan, case No. 2:17-CV-14148, entered April 25, 2019, is stayed pending the timely filing and disposition of an appeal in this Court or further order of this Court.
